# hp_logger

> Zero-dependency structured logger for Bun and Node.js: leveled logging, secret
> redaction, file/database output, flood control, spans and traces, Prometheus-style
> metrics, worker-thread transports and web framework integrations.

Version: 1.1.1. License: MIT. Author: HullPerse.
Repo: https://github.com/HullPerse/hp_logger
Issues: https://github.com/HullPerse/hp_logger/issues
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/hp_logger

## Install

```bash
bun add hp_logger
# or
npm install hp_logger
```

Subpath exports: `hp_logger` (root), `hp_logger/elysia`, `hp_logger/bun`,
`hp_logger/node`, `hp_logger/hono`, `hp_logger/fastify`, `hp_logger/http`
(web log viewer), `hp_logger/worker` (worker-thread transport),
`hp_logger/database` (DatabaseTransport + createSqliteAdapter), `hp_logger/test`
(test helpers).

## Quick start

```ts
import { createLogger } from "hp_logger";

const logger = createLogger({ settings: { level: "info", mode: "pretty" } });
logger.info("server started", { port: 3000 });

const auth = logger.module("auth", { level: "debug" }); // per-module logger
auth.info("user registered", { userId: 42 });
```

## Core API

- `createLogger({ settings?, author? })` - root logger.
- `logger.module(name, settings?)` - child logger; `LOG_MODULES=auth:debug,http:warn`
  env var overrides module levels with prefix wildcards (`web*:debug`), `*` sets a default.
- `logger.child(context)` - child with persistent context.
- `logger.settings(patch)` - change settings at runtime (also on modules).
- Level methods: `logger.trace/debug/info/success/warn/error/fatal(message, context?)`
  (also `(context, message)` and bare-object forms). Lazy forms:
  `logger.debug(() => expensive())`.
- `logger.withContext(ctx, fn)` - AsyncLocalStorage request scope.
- `logger.time(name, fn, { maxMs? })` - log duration of async work.
- `logger.span(name)` / `logger.span(name, cb)` / `logger.span(name, { traceId, parentSpanId }, cb)`
  - spans with trace tree; `logger.traceTree(traceId?)` renders it. Entries
  written inside a callback span or task carry `spanPath` (root-to-leaf names).
  W3C trace context: `parseTraceparent(header)` / `buildTraceparent({ traceId, spanId })`.
- `logger.task(name)` / `logger.task(name, cb)` - pending-task entries with
  duration; `handle.update(text)` progress (needs `task.progress`), `handle.done()`,
  `handle.fail(err?)`.
- `logger.assert(condition, message?)`, `logger.group(name)`, `logger.groupEnd()`.
- `logger.once(key, msg)`, `logger.throttle(key, ms, msg)`, `logger.table(rows)`.
- `logger.watch(options, hooks?)` - endpoint/availability probes; optional
  exponential `backoff` with jitter after failures, reset on success.
- `logger.stats()`, `logger.flush()`, `logger.close()`, `logger.dump(path?)`.
- `logger.pause()` - buffer up to 10_000 entries instead of dispatching (drop-newest past the cap); `logger.stats()` reports the queue under `paused` (`queued`/`dropped`); `await logger.resume()` drains in FIFO order.
- `logger.rotate()` - force rotation on transports that support it (size-based file writers).
- `logger.counter/gauge/histogram(...)`, `logger.metricsText()` - Prometheus format.- `Logger.addTransport(t, { level? })`, `Logger.removeTransport(t)`, `Logger.clearTransports()`.
- `installErrorHandlers(logger)` - logs uncaughtException/unhandledRejection,
  dumps the black box and flushes transports.
- `captureConsole(logger)` - route console.* into the logger.
- `fromEnv()` - env-driven factory: LOG_LEVEL, LOG_MODULES, LOG_MODE, LOG_FILE,
  LOG_COLOR, LOG_AUTHOR.

## Settings

- `level` (default info, or LOG_LEVEL), `mode` ("pretty" | "json", adaptive default).
- `colors` per level or false; `tagCase`; `emoji`; `showTime/showDate/showYear/showLevel/showAuthor/showElapsed`.
- `format.template` - custom lines: `"[{timestamp.time}] [{level.tag}] {message}"`.
  Tokens: message, author, level, level.tag, context, context.kv, elapsed,
  group.indent, timestamp.year/.month/.day/.hour/.minute/.second/.ms/.time/.date/.weekday,
  task.frame, task.glyph, retry.attempt, any context key. Colors: `{token:red}`,
  `{:green}span{:/}`. Unknown dotted tokens render literally (warn once).
- `format` - full custom renderer function (console + file).
- `redactKeys` (RegExp, default standard secret keys), `redactPaths`
  (e.g. ["user.password", "secrets.*"]), `redactDepth` (default 2),
  `redactCensor` (replacement token, default "[REDACTED]"),
  `redactPii` ({ email?, card? } or false) - opt-in email and card number
detection in messages and context strings.
- `serializers` - per-key transformers applied before redaction.
- `baseFields` (Record<string, unknown> | false) - static metadata fields
  stamped onto every entry as top-level JSON fields (pid, hostname, service).
- `mixin(context, level)` - enrichment hook merged under every entry context
  before serializers and redaction; explicit data wins, output is redacted.
- `resolvers` - per-key async enrichment lookups with a bounded cache:
  `resolvers: { userId: { as: "username", resolve: async (id) => (await users.find(id))?.username } }`.
  Object results merge their own keys; scalars land under `as`. Per-value
  cache with `ttlMs` (default 60s) and per-lookup `timeoutMs` (default 50ms,
  falls back to the raw value); `onError: "mark"` records a
  `[RESOLVER ERROR]` marker instead of skipping (`onTimeout` defaults to
  `onError`). Only applies to loggers
  that configure resolvers; the sync fast path is untouched.
- `file.fsync` - fsync the descriptor on close for strict durability.
- `schemaVersion` - stamp `v: 1` on every entry; sqlite adapter option adds a
  `version` column (old tables fail validation with an ALTER TABLE hint).
- `file`: `{ enabled, path, mode, rotation: "daily" | "size" | "none", splitByLevel?,
  maxBytes?, maxFiles?, gzip?, flushInterval?, maxBufferSize?, maxFilesPerDay? }`.
  splitByLevel writes `app.error.log` per level; size rotation keeps `app.N.log`
  segments with retention and optional gzip. Paths with `..` segments are
  blocked; absolute paths outside the cwd warn.
- `database`: `{ enabled, adapter | createAdapter, level?, maxBufferSize?,
  flushInterval?, retry?: { attempts=5, backoff="exponential"|"linear"|"fixed",
  baseMs=1000, maxMs=30000, jitter=0 }, reconnect?: { cooldownMs=5000, maxAttempts=3 } }`.
  Self-healing: after the retry cap the adapter is rebuilt via the factory and
  the buffered backlog drains.
- `batching`: `{ batchSize, maxQueueSize=10000, flushInterval, flushOn?: LogLevel[] }`
  - bounded queue, drop-newest, `logger.stats()`.
- `bufferedConsole: true` - coalesce console lines into one stdio write per
  flush window (timer/line cap/close/crash). About 3x faster end to end on
  real output; the tail since the last flush is lost on a hard kill.
- `repeat`: `{ windowMs, maxKeys }` - collapse duplicates into `message xN`.
- `adaptive`: `{ windowMs, errorRate, sample, cooldownMs }` - error-storm sampling.
- `sampling`: `{ rate, perTrace? }` - trace-coherent sampling (error/fatal pass).
- `blackbox`: `{ size=1000, path? }` - flight recorder; dumped on crash or `logger.dump()`. Same path rules as `file`: `..` blocked, outside-cwd warns.
- `task`: `{ level="debug", progress=false }`.
- `stripControl` - strip terminal escapes from logged data (log-injection defense).
- `box`: `{ error?, fatal?, storm? }` - ASCII frames around error chains, fatal
  bodies and adaptive storm notices in pretty output. Off by default.
- `profile: true | { maxOperations }` - operation timers feed
  `logger.metricsBox()` / `metricsText()` snapshots (p50/p95/count/sum per name).

## Integrations

- Elysia: `elysiaPlugin(logger, { skipPaths?, onFinish? })` - no automatic
  correlation scope: wrap handlers with `logger.withContext({ correlationId })`
  yourself when logs inside must carry the request id.
- Bun.serve: `bunServe(handler, logger, { skipPaths?, onFinish? })`
- Node http: `nodeServer(handler, logger, { skipPaths?, onFinish? })`
- Hono: `honoMiddleware(logger, { skipPaths?, onFinish? })`
- Fastify: `fastifyPlugin(instance, logger, { skipPaths?, onFinish? })`
All log method/path/status/duration with correlation ids; 2xx info, 4xx warn, 5xx error.
Handler errors are logged at error level with status 500 and rethrown;
`onFinish` fires for every finished request including skipped paths.

## Worker transport

```ts
import { createThreadTransport } from "hp_logger/worker";
const t = createThreadTransport({ file: { enabled: true, path: "logs/app.log" } });
Logger.addTransport(t);
```
JSON-safe settings only (no RegExp/functions across the thread boundary).
Crashed workers restart automatically with exponential backoff (1s base, 30s cap).

## Test helpers

```ts
import { captureLogger } from "hp_logger/test";
const { entries, logger } = captureLogger({ level: "debug" });
logger.info("captured");
```

## Web viewer

```ts
import { createLogServer, LogBuffer } from "hp_logger/http";
const buffer = new LogBuffer(1000);
Logger.addTransport(buffer.transport);
createLogServer(buffer, { port: 8787, token: "secret" });
// GET /hp_logger/logs?after=<cursor>
```

## Guarantees

- Zero runtime dependencies; the published tarball contains only dist + llms.txt + README + CHANGELOG + LICENSE.
- Redaction runs before every transport; error/fatal bypass sampling.
- No outbound network by default: watch probes and the http viewer are opt-in.
